home.title: Build interfaces.
home.intro: A Rust UI library for applications that feel right. From the first button to the whole window.
home.preview: The real thing. Built with Argui.
home.previewAlt: Argui's WebAssembly widget gallery showing interactive button variants and GPU hover effects
home.foundation:
A small footprint.
Room for big ideas.
home.foundationBody: A retained UI tree, shaped text and a GPU renderer. The parts you need to build an application, with the freedom to make it yours.
home.codeBody: Compose your interface with typed building blocks. Enable the widgets you need, and keep application state in your hands.

stats.evidence: Measured on Linux with the release gallery. Memory depends on features and workload.

features.title: Built for the whole application.

performance.title: Work only when it changes.
performance.body: Retained subtrees, explicit dirty tracking and virtualized lists keep repeated work out of the frame. Idle views do not request continuous redraws.

accessibility.title: Accessibility is part of the tree.
accessibility.body: Semantic roles, accessible names, keyboard navigation, focus management and reduced-motion support are built into the widgets.

shaders.title: Give pixels a little personality.
shaders.body: GPU effects, gradients, blur and custom WGSL shaders share the renderer. Apply effects to a surface, a component or a whole layer.

popovers.title: Beyond the window.
popovers.body: Opt-in native popup surfaces let menus, tooltips and popovers extend beyond application window bounds, with platform-specific hosting.

updater.title: Keep your application current.
updater.body: An optional update engine checks signed feeds, downloads with progress and hands off installation. Add the separate dialog feature when you want a ready-made UI.

platforms.title: The same UI, in more places.
platforms.body: A WGPU renderer for desktop and WebAssembly. Native window integration on Linux, macOS and Windows; WebGPU in the browser.

hotReload.title: Keep state while Rust changes.
hotReload.body: Optional Subsecond hot patching refreshes render functions, handlers and application callbacks in native debug builds while retaining live model state.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.body: Optional Fluent catalogs provide locale negotiation, message fallback, variables, plurals and writing direction for native and WebAssembly applications.

features.experimental: Argui is experimental and actively developed. Follow the repository for API changes and platform progress.

start.title: Make something native.
start.intro: Start with the gallery, then bring the pieces you need into your own Rust application.
start.runBody: Clone the repository and run the native widget gallery. Cargo builds with a maximum of six parallel jobs in this repository.
start.addBody: Argui is in active development. Use the Git dependency and select individual widget features for your application.
start.composeBody: A small, typed view using the same Button and Element APIs as the gallery.
start.prerequisites: Install Rust and the native dependencies for your platform. The Linux setup guide covers the optional WebView and native integrations.
